parameters.query:
=SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.total_amount, o.currency, o.carrier, o.tracking_number, o.estimated_delivery, o.items, c.full_name
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_number ILIKE '%{{ ($json.entities?.order_number || 'UNKNOWN').replace(/'/g, "''") }}%' OR c.phone_number = '{{ ($json.customer?.phone_number || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
